notes: Lat/lon is the single site POSITION on DTU's documentation page (57°0'6.23"N 9°24'35.08"E), not a mean of turbines: the page gives turbine positions only as local x-y, many of them placeholders. Capacity is 42 x 330 kW (Nordtank NTK 300F) as listed on that page; the data files hold power for 40 turbines (a1 and f6 absent). Not to be confused with the neighbouring Nørrekær Enge I (36 x 150 kW).
